findings.title: FCM push notification bodies hardcoded in Chinese
findings.description: All push notification titles and bodies (SOS alert, checkin reminder, heartbeat missing, SOS resolved) are hardcoded in Chinese. No per-recipient locale routing.
findings.fixDescription: Added fcmStrings dict (zh/en/fr) + getUserLocale() per-recipient routing for all 5 notification types

findings.title: SMS templates hardcoded in Chinese
findings.description: All SMS templates (SOS, checkin reminder, verification) are hardcoded in Chinese only. No per-recipient locale.
findings.fixDescription: Added smsStrings dict (zh/en/fr) + getUserLocale() for SOS/checkin SMS, phone prefix heuristic for verification SMS

findings.title: TwiML voice language based on protected person's country, not guardian's locale
findings.description: getTwimlLanguage() uses the protected person's countryCode to select voice language, but the guardian receiving the call may speak a different language.

findings.title: SOS rate limit preset exists but not mounted on route
findings.description: The 'sos' rate limit preset (3/hr) was not applied to the SOS trigger route. Fixed: added createRateLimiter(RATE_LIMITS.sos) middleware to POST /trigger.

findings.title: Missing Storage and Pub/Sub emulators in firebase.json
findings.description: Storage and Pub/Sub emulators were not configured. Added in Phase 1 harness setup.

findings.title: 10 Firestore collections have no explicit security rules
findings.description: Collections checkins, home_timers, medical_cards, selected_hotlines, arrival_reports, itineraries, evidence_shares, medical_card_shares, rate_limits, claim_material_exports rely on default deny. This is secure but means the app is fully server-dependent for these collections.

findings.title: iOS push action buttons hardcoded in Chinese
findings.description: UNNotificationAction titles are hardcoded in Chinese: '我已接手', '立即拨号', '我知道了', '我很好，报个平安'. Should use NSLocalizedString.

findings.title: iOS local notification content hardcoded in Chinese
findings.description: Local notification titles and bodies (checkin reminder, duty handoff, SOS alert) are hardcoded in Chinese. Should use localized strings.

findings.title: HeartbeatService battery alert message hardcoded in Chinese
findings.description: BatteryAlert.message uses String(format: '电量仅%.0f%%，即将关机'...) hardcoded in Chinese.

findings.title: BaselineScorer risk explanations hardcoded in Chinese
findings.description: All humanReadableReasons in BaselineScorer are hardcoded in Chinese. Should use localized strings.

findings.title: No China SMS gateway for +86 numbers
findings.description: Twilio is the sole SMS provider. Twilio has limited delivery rates to mainland China +86 numbers.

findings.title: Geocoding hardcoded to zh-CN language
findings.description: reverseGeocode() always requests language=zh-CN from Google Maps API.

findings.title: No fallback geocoding provider for China
findings.description: Google Maps API is blocked in mainland China. No fallback provider configured.

findings.title: No PIPL data residency configuration for Chinese users
findings.description: China market requires a separate version deployed on domestic servers.

findings.title: handleFallCandidate() does not show confirmation dialog
findings.description: AppCoordinator.handleFallCandidate() at line 835-839 only prints a debug log. No UI confirmation dialog is presented.
findings.fixDescription: Added FallConfirmationOverlay.swift with 60s countdown + 'I'm Fine' button. Wired to showFallConfirmation @Published + RootView overlay. i18n: zh/en/fr strings added.

findings.title: medicalCard.ts queries 'relationships' collection — wrong collection, no rules
findings.description: GET/PUT /v1/medical-card/:userId verify guardianship via 'relationships' collection, but rest of app uses 'guardian_links'. Guardian medical card access always returns 403.
findings.fixDescription: Changed collection('relationships') → collection('guardian_links') on lines 201 and 264

findings.title: Voice callback TwiML hardcoded Chinese only
findings.description: /v1/voice-callback returns TwiML with hardcoded Chinese. EN/FR users get unintelligible emergency voice calls.
findings.fixDescription: Added voiceMessages dict (zh/en/fr) with ?lang= query param routing

findings.title: TrajectoryProcessor.maxSpeedKmh declared but never used in filter
findings.description: Config.maxSpeedKmh=200 declared but filterLayer() only checks flyingSpeedKmh=1200. Points at 200-1200 km/h pass through.
findings.fixDescription: Added two-tier speed filter: >flyingSpeedKmh always rejected; >maxSpeedKmh rejected unless device-reported speed confirms flight

findings.title: LegalView.swift — privacy policy and terms entirely hardcoded Chinese
findings.description: ~60 lines of hardcoded Chinese legal text. FR/EN users see Chinese privacy policy and terms of service.

findings.title: GuardianRecordsView.swift — 65+ hardcoded Chinese strings
findings.description: Timeline, schedule, contacts, invite, member management sections all hardcoded Chinese. Mock data with Chinese names.

findings.title: ProtectedRecordsView.swift — 30+ hardcoded Chinese strings
findings.description: Timeline, emergency contacts, export, upsell sections all hardcoded Chinese.

findings.title: ProfileEditView.swift — 18 hardcoded Chinese strings
ArrivalReportView.swift — 11 hardcoded Chinese strings
findings.description: Including quickPlaces array with Chinese location names.

findings.title: BiometricEnablePromptView.swift — 4 hardcoded Chinese strings
GuardianDutyScheduleView.swift — 13 hardcoded Chinese strings
FamilyFeedView.swift — hardcoded Chinese in confirmation dialogs and buttons
EscalationEngine has no SMS fallback path (client-side)
findings.description: Client-side EscalationEngine has no SMS fallback. Note: real escalation runs server-side in onSOSCreated.ts which does have SMS fallback at Hop 2.

findings.title: TransportMode raw values are hardcoded Chinese
findings.description: TransportMode enum raw values were Chinese. Changed to English identifiers.
findings.fixDescription: Changed raw values to English identifiers (walking, cycling, driving, flying, stationary, unknown)

findings.title: Hop 3 voice calls only on-duty guardians, not all
findings.description: onSOSCreated.ts Hop 3 (line 179) iterates hop1Targets (on-duty only) instead of guardianIds (all). If on-duty guardian is unavailable, off-duty guardians never get voice calls.
findings.fixDescription: Changed hop1Targets → guardianIds in Hop 3 voice call loop

findings.title: Voice callback does not freeze SOS in Firestore
findings.description: When guardian presses '1' on voice call, the callback logs acknowledgement but does not update the SOS Firestore doc. Escalation chain continues regardless of voice acknowledgement.
findings.fixDescription: Added Firestore query to find active SOS at hop 3 and set escalationState='frozen', frozenBy='voice_callback'

findings.title: Fall confirmation timer stops when app backgrounds
findings.description: FallConfirmationOverlay used Timer.publish on .main RunLoop which stops when app goes to background. 60-second safety countdown could stall indefinitely if user switches apps.
findings.fixDescription: Replaced Timer.publish with DispatchSourceTimer on .global queue + UIBackgroundTask. Countdown now computes remaining time from absolute deadline, not relative decrement.

findings.title: Client EscalationEngine.startEscalation() never called — dead code
findings.description: AppCoordinator.triggerSOS() calls apiClient.post('/v1/sos/trigger') but never calls escalationEngine.startEscalation(). The entire client-side EscalationEngine is dead code. Real escalation runs server-side via onSOSCreated Firestore trigger.
findings.note: Not a bug per se — server-side escalation works correctly. Client engine is legacy/unused.

findings.title: SOS timeline entry outside transaction
findings.description: POST /v1/sos/trigger: SOS doc creation is in transaction (correct), but timeline entry is separate. Timeline is informational only. Also fixed hardcoded Chinese in trigger/resolution labels and fallback names.
findings.fixDescription: Removed hardcoded Chinese from triggerLabels, resolutionLabels, and fallback names. Timeline non-atomicity is acceptable (informational only).

findings.title: HomeTimerResponse schema mismatch — POST response missing non-optional fields
findings.description: POST /v1/home-timer response doesn't include all fields that GET response includes. Client may crash on missing fields.
